thread:
nina: Heads-up: vendor pen test intake form arrived. They want: RBAC list, KMS key access plan, and an evidence export procedure. Can we sketch a minimal playbook and a retest window?

raj: I can handle RBAC. Proposal: create ephemeral roles with TTL 8h and tag `pt:run=vendor-046`. Roles: pt-assessor-reader, pt-assessor-uploader, pt-assessor-netdiag. Scope to staging account only.

oliver: For KMS, create a dedicated key alias/pt-evidence-sign and restrict to an ops signing proxy service. Use GenerateDataKey for envelope encryption for uploads. No key rotation during the window.

sec-bot: Note: earlier assessment found overly broad S3 prefixes (SI-712). Enforce bucket policy to limit PutObject to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-uploader` and S3 prefix `evidence/vendor-046/*`.

ops-oncall: I'll provision the S3 prefix and lifecycle. Quick bucket policy example: \n```json\n{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-uploader"},"Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging/evidence/vendor-046/*"}]}\n```\nWill wire presigned endpoint to require KMS envelope headers.

raj: IAM snippet to allow limited S3 read for netdiag role: \n```json\n{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging","arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging/*"],"Condition":{"StringLike":{"s3:prefix":"evidence/vendor-046/*"}}}]}\n```\nI'll open PR with assume-role policy and automated revoke hook (revoke runs 30m after window end).

nina: Audit logging: include CloudTrail management + data events for S3 and KMS key usage logs. Export slices for the test run and store under `s3://pt-evidence-archive/vendor-046/`. Retain for 12 months. @ops-oncall please enable server access logs.

triage-bot: Suggestion: create GH issue template `pt-remediation` and add webhook to post new issues to #incidents for P0/P1.

oliver: KMS policy must whitelist the signing proxy service principal and ops team. Example sign permission only: `kms:Sign`, `kms:Verify`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`. Will avoid giving Decrypt to assessor roles.

ops-oncall: Timeline: dry-run on 2026-07-10 09:00-11:00 PT, external window 2026-07-17 to 2026-07-21, retest reserve 2026-07-31. I'll create calendar blocks and the S3 prefix now.

nina: Action items:
- @raj: PR for ephemeral roles + revoke hook (today)
- @oliver: KMS key policy + example envelope flow (EOD)
- @ops-oncall: create prefix, enable access logs, presign endpoint (today)
- @triage-bot: GH template + incident webhook (this week)
We'll run the dry-run in #release-war-room. If anything blocks overnight ping me.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1501. Roles created in staging and smoke-tested.

ops-oncall: S3 prefix created: s3://pt-evidence-staging/evidence/vendor-046/. Server access logs enabled and replicating to s3://pt-evidence-audit/. Presigned endpoint URL: https://upload.redwood.company/vendors/046.

oliver: KMS key created and policy attached. Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-cc33-44dd-88ee-ff0011223344. Only signing proxy + ops principal allowed kms:Sign and kms:GenerateDataKey.

nina: Great. After dry-run, revoke all assessor roles and post manifest + log slice here. We'll then lock retest slots until remediation tracker shows fixes assigned. Closing thread unless blockers arise.
